Circular two-leg ladders have different degree and graph connectivity; their Ising magnetization classification does not cover the coordinate-clique Boolean-cube graphs.

value.rationale: The d=3 member is the natural 24-site frustrated rhombicuboctahedral spin network, not an arbitrary slice. The theorem exactly computes sector energies and all magnetic field transitions for an infinite geometrically motivated graph family of exponential size, exposing a dimension-parity effect. It supplies the separate full 24-spin critical coexistence census needed for finite-cluster benchmarking. Methods and generic max-cut correspondence alone are explicitly excluded from originality.
